plugin.name: Sketchfab
plugin.description: Search Sketchfab from the Library: downloadable 3D models under CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA.
plugin.longDescription: Adds a Sketchfab tab to the Library with downloadable 3D models, by category: characters, animals, vehicles, weapons, nature, buildings, furniture, food and tech. It searches only CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA, which allow commercial use and changes, and keeps each model's author, license and Sketchfab page. Browsing, searching and thumbnails need no account; adding a model downloads it as GLB, which Sketchfab allows only once you sign in to Sketchfab in this plugin's Settings or paste your Sketchfab API token there.
source.title: Sketchfab
source.description: Downloadable 3D models under CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA, added as GLB. Searches are sent to Sketchfab. Adding a model needs a Sketchfab sign-in in this plugin's Settings. Credit the author shown with each one; CC BY-SA asks for changes to be shared alike.
config.apiToken.title: Sketchfab API token
config.apiToken.description: Optional, instead of Sign in with Sketchfab. Copy it from Sketchfab's Settings › Password & API (Get API token opens that page). Saved as a secret on this computer and sent only to Sketchfab, to download the models you add.
